title: Profile tab and settings - part 1 of 3 (G-724..G-736; mainly profile_screen.dart, date_dropdown_field.dart, loyalty_rank_card.dart)

guards.situation: When the profile screen opens, the cached profile is thrown away and reloaded so that a stale or empty cache (right after registration) is never shown or edited.
guards.customer_sees: A short loading state, then fresh data.
guards.verdict_evidence: initState runs before the MgV2.on branch at :234, so v2 gets the same reload. v2 adds pull-to-refresh that calls the same invalidate (profile_hub_v2.dart:120-125).
